title: Stork Wrong Address
premise: The stork has the right nest and the wrong baby. The flamingos check the clipboard. The baby alligator waves. Nobody is sending it back.
visual: Cliff nest at sunset. Tall pink stork in a courier cap, delivery satchel, holding a bundled baby alligator with a blue bow. Two flamingos on the nest, one holding a clipboard with a picture of a flamingo chick, the other poking the alligator. The alligator is waving. A trail of other storks in the sky, all carrying equally wrong animals.
